description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Icon', a PHP class for rendering image-based markers in a graphing utility, including methods for setting icon position and drawing the icon on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
classes.description: A class for creating image icon markers in a graph, with properties for filename and position, and methods for setting position and rendering the icon.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
methods.description: Constructor for the icon marker, initializes with filename and optional size.

methods.name: setPointX
methods.description: Sets the X coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: setPointY
methods.description: Sets the Y coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the icon marker on the canvas at specified coordinates.
